GradCafe Analytics Documentation
================================

Welcome to the documentation for the GradCafe Analytics application.

This project uses Flask, PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy, Pytest, and Sphinx to
collect, process, analyze, test, and document graduate admissions data.
